restrictions: Target is the exact fixed-IV sha256-r31-prefix-v1 hash of complete 40-byte messages: original SHA-256 schedule/constants, round indices 0 through 30 on the one FIPS-padded block, all eight feed-forward words, full 256-bit digest.

Draw exactly q=2^128 independent uniform 40-byte messages from two fresh independent uniform 256-bit RAM words per message. Store every message and its full digest; sort every record with four stable 64-bit radix passes and scan for distinct-message equal-digest neighbors.

Charge q selected-round compressions, at most two additional verification compressions, at most 192q+2^74+2^24 other word operations, all memory, all failed samples, every bucket sweep, the full sort and final scan. No nonuniform advice, witness lookup, restart, or differential heuristic.

Use a theoretical 256-bit word RAM with random-access 2^64-word counter array, two two-word record arrays and a two-word message array; peak memory remains below 2^136 bytes. This is an astronomically large analytic attack, not a practical search.
